caption: The drawing depicts two views of a glass cup, rendered in shades of gray and black on an off-white background. The upper view shows the complete cup, which has a wide rim with horizontal lines, a slightly tapering body, and a broad, circular foot with a raised base. The body of the cup is decorated with an engraved bird perched on a branch with leaves and some small flowers or fruit. The lower view presents a detail of the cup's body, viewed from the side and without the foot or stem, focusing on the bird and branch pattern, which is almost identical to the decoration seen in the upper view. The overall composition is balanced vertically, with the larger, complete cup above and the detailed fragment below. Both sections illustrate the transparency and reflectiveness of the glass using fine linework and shading.
title: Spoon Holder
